Only 5 min to Broadway by car, 10 min by scooter, or a 30-min walk through Nashville’s most charming neighborhood.

The space
What Guests Are Saying (the praise and the real talk)

Guests consistently love:

❤️Clean, true-to-photos spaces.
“Spotless,” “exactly as pictured,” “exceptionally clean.”

❤️ Location & value. Walkable Germantown vibe; 5–10 min rides to Broadway; “close to everything without the chaos.”

❤️Clear check-in + fast communication. “Instructions were crystal clear,” “hosts responded immediately,” “felt taken care of.”

❤️ Free gated parking & safety. Many note feeling safe and loving the gated lot.

And here’s the honest stuff - so you know exactly what to expect:

⚠️Finding the entrance: The complex spans multiple gates and doors.
→ We send an annotated map + step-by-step codes 24–48 hrs before arrival, re-send on check-in day, and stay on call to guide you.

⚠️Pool and Corridors: Building-managed and seasonal - a few guests found pool closed, drained, or under maintenance.
→ If the pool matters to you, please message us before booking so we can confirm its current status.

⚠️Typical apartment sounds/light: Some mention light street noise, footsteps, or exterior lighting.
→ This 3rd floor apartment is typically quieter than ground or 2nd floor. There is a white noise machine in the bedroom. Quiet hours apply across the community.

⚠️Stairs/no elevator: This specific apartment is a 3rd floor walk up. There is no elevator.

⚠️Neighborhood mix: Germantown borders busier corridors. Most guests say it’s peaceful and safe; a few recommend rideshare after dark.
→ We share best-lit walking routes and clear arrival instructions so you never feel lost.

⚠️House rules: Pet hair on furniture = cleaning fees; gated lot uses fobs that must be returned.
→ These rules keep the next guest’s stay just as great as yours.

Guest access
The apartment complex spans multiple cross-streets and entrances. We’ll send:

⦿ Exact address & best GPS pin
⦿ Annotated map (parking lot, pedestrian gates, glass-door entrance)
⦿ Building/entrance codes + how to use the gated lot key fob
⦿ Your apartment door code at noon on check-in day

Other things to note
🏠 Building Character
The Ellis is a classic gated community - modern apartments inside a traditional property. The units themselves are newly furnished and meticulously cleaned. May show light wear typical of a residential community.

💡Noise & Light
This specific unit is on the third floor (typically quieter than the ground-floor apartments) and faces the main road. While some light traffic noise may be heard during peak hours, bedroom has white noise machine for added comfort.

🏊Pool & Amenities
The pool and fitness center are shared community amenities managed by the building (not the host). Availability and cleanliness can vary seasonally; we always communicate if they’re closed for maintenance.

🛡️Safety & Neighborhood Context
Germantown is one of Nashville’s most sought-after neighborhoods but still urban in feel - a mix of historic homes and modern developments. Guests note it feels safe and walkable by day with easy Uber access at night.

✓ Early check-in considered case by case (earliest 2 PM for $25 fee)

✘ No locals without prior approval
✘ No pets (except approved service animals)
✘ $200 fee for pet-related damage, evidence on furniture, or unapproved pets
✘ $75 fee for lost or damaged parking fobs
✘ No late check-outs on day of departure

✦ We’re dedicated to an honest, comfortable, and transparent stay - message us anytime with questions or feedback. ✦
